name: Euroopan vapaareititetty digitaalinen kävelyreitti E6, Suomi
description_md:
The international waymarked hiking network includes the waymarked hiking route signposted as E6, located in Norway. This hard route covers a distance of 68.8 km and requires about 20 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

Walkers face 1248 m of ascent and 1145 m of descent along the path. The difficulty of the journey is derived from the distance and ascent.
